Prevent iOS Safari demotion from notification clicks through SPA routing Service worker notification clicks were forcing hard navigation via client.navigate() or openWindow(), which on iOS standalone PWAs causes the browser to open a fresh browser context, demoting the app from the standalone window to Safari. Instead: - Existing app windows now receive postMessage for navigation routes through the SPA - New windows open at /dashboard with the target as a launch query param - Client-side handler consumes launch param to route in-app via Next router - Falls back to service worker message routing for older-style clicks Restores manifest id for stable app identity across updates.
